\section{Per-system sensitivity}
\label{app:persys}

The limit Table~\ref{tab:persys} quotes for a system is that of its best
window, so a system whose coverage is wide is not penalised for the
shallowest window in it; the whole distribution, window by window, is the
per-window result the sensitivity of \S\ref{sec:pninetysel} is drawn from.

The limits span more than two orders of magnitude, so no single survey depth
describes the sample, and the frequency at which a system's best limit falls
is set by what the archive happens to hold toward it rather than by any
property of the star. A limit also says nothing about whether a crossing there
could have been followed up: for \ZcNoRepSys{} of the \NSysClassA{} systems
no sensitivity would have been enough, because no block more than a day away
covers a frequency the first one did.
